title: NPC压力服无氧气
description: NPC穿着无氧气瓶的压力服，导致倒地。
evidence: You'll regularly find NPCs lying on the ground wearing pressure suits. The issue is that these suits don't have oxygen tanks; they only contain whatever air pressure is already inside them.
